concepts.name: INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY GRADE 11 ~ STUDEN
concepts.simple_definition: INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY GRADE 11 ~ STUDENT TEXTBOOK 140 UNIT-6 Fundamentals of Programming The example that follows shows how a variable named “y” is created and assigned to the result of an expression
concepts.deep_explanation: The value of “y” would be the sum of 5 and 9, which is 14
concepts.real_example: Practical example of INFORMATION TECHNOLOGY GRADE 11 ~ STUDEN from page 146.

concepts.deep_explanation_amharic: [አማርኛ ማብራሪያ] The value of “y” would be the sum of 5 and 9, which is 14 — ይህ ጽንሰ-ሐሳብ ተማሪዎች በክፍል ውስጥ የተማሩትን በቀላሉ እንዲረዱ ይረዳቸዋል።
concepts.real_example_amharic: [አማርኛ] በገጽ 146 ላይ ያለውን ተግባራዊ ምሳሌ ይመልከቱ።
